- ~Grazing: normal rain under 30 mm in 6 months, when forage and surface water are usually scarcer
- Soil (SoilGrids model): Lixisols, sandy clay loam
- ENSO La Niña (weak); moon first quarter; day length 12.6 h, lengthening
